newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Oiltanking Seraya to invest $$14 mln on facilities.
newsitem.headline: Oiltanking Seraya to invest $$14 mln on facilities.

text.p: Power Gen (Seraya), a subsidiary of Singapore Power, said on Monday its joint venture with Oiltanking Singapore Limited Co, Oiltanking Seraya Pte Ltd, plans to invest Singapore $14 million in additional oil infrastructure.
The announcement followed a joint venture agreement signed between PowerGen (Seraya) Investment Pte Ltd, a wholly owned subisidiary of Power Gen (Seraya) and Oil Tanking Singapore Ltd.
The company said in a statement that with the joint venture, a series of new pipelines will be built, connecting Seraya's tanks and jetty to Oiltanking's facilities.
"Additional loading and unloading facilites will also be constructed," it said.
"The tanks will be refurbished and pump equipment installed. The investment for these additional infrastructure and facilities will amount to about S$14 million," it said.
